title: 第6章 不谈真心，不赌人性
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

祁晏辞刚运动完，额发被汗水浸湿，几缕贴在额前。深灰色运动背心勾出宽肩窄腰，身上带着未散的热气。

和平时的冷淡疏离不同，多了几分侵略感。

时夏禾不敢多看，赶紧把毛巾和水递过去。

“祁先生，刚运动完要补水。”

她顿了顿，又补了一句：“不过别喝太急，先小口喝。刚出了汗，也别马上冲冷水澡。”

祁晏辞低头看了她一眼。

女孩扎着松散的丸子头，几缕碎发贴在白净的脸侧，一双眼睛又圆又亮。

手里举着水和毛巾，表情紧绷得像等着判卷。

祁晏辞眼底掠过一丝极淡的诧异。

他沉默片刻，伸手接过水，拧开喝了一口。

时夏禾见他没拒绝，胆子稍微大了点。

“您今晚运动量有些大，待会儿可以泡一下脚，放松小腿肌肉。”

她试探着补了一句：“如果您需要，我也可以配个简单的舒缓药包。”

祁晏辞擦汗的动作一停，抬眼看她。

“你倒是什么都敢管。”

时夏禾心口一跳，连忙解释：“不是管，是服务范围内的合理建议。您可以不采纳，我只是觉得，既然拿了钱，总不能只会站在旁边说好。”

空气安静了两秒。

祁晏辞忽然扯了下唇角。

很浅，几乎看不出来。

“歪理不少。”

时夏禾分不清这是夸还是讽，只能低头：“您说得对。”

祁晏辞：“……”

他没再接话，拿着毛巾和水转身往主卧走。

也没有提药包的事。

时夏禾站在原地，慢慢攥紧了手指。

她看得出来，祁晏辞并不信她。

或者说，他只允许她做饭、递水、守规矩。

真正涉及身体的东西，他不会轻易交给她。

没关系。

至少他没有赶她走。

只要还留在这里，她就还有机会。

时夏禾回到客房，手机刚好响了。

她接起电话。

姜柠开口就问：“阿禾，听房东说你搬走了？你搬去哪儿了？”

时夏禾一顿。

她签过保密协议，不能透露江屿府，也不能说假结婚，便只道：“我找了份新工作，包吃包住，就搬走了。”

姜柠松了口气：“那太好了，至少不用再跟那个渣男挤出租屋了。”

顿了顿，她又问：“你还好吗？要不要出来喝一杯？我陪你骂他。”

时夏禾看了眼时间，已经不早了。

“今天算了，你放心，我挺好的。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qi Yanci had just finished exercising, his forehead hair was soaked with sweat, and a few strands were stuck to his forehead.The dark gray sports vest outlines the wide shoulders and narrow waist, and there is still heat in the body.

Different from the usual coldness and alienation, there is a bit more aggression.

Shi Xiahe didn't dare to look any further and quickly handed over the towel and water.

"Mr. Qi, I just need to replenish water after exercising."

She paused and then added: "But don't drink too quickly. Drink in small sips first. Don't take a cold shower right away if you just sweat."

Qi Yanci lowered his head and glanced at her.

The girl has a loose bun, a few strands of hair stuck to the side of her fair face, and her eyes are round and bright.

He was holding water and towels in his hands, and his expression was as tense as if he was waiting for the paper to be judged.

A trace of slight surprise flashed across Qi Yanci's eyes.

He was silent for a moment, then reached out to take the water, opened it and took a sip.

Seeing that he didn't refuse, Shi Xiahe became a little bolder.

"You've been exercising quite a bit tonight. You can soak your feet later to relax your calf muscles."

She tentatively added: "If you need it, I can also prepare a simple soothing medicine package."

Qi Yanci stopped wiping his sweat and raised his eyes to look at her.

"You dare to take care of everything."

Shi Xiahe's heart skipped a beat and he quickly explained: "It's not a matter of control, it's a reasonable suggestion within the scope of the service. You don't have to accept it. I just think that since you have taken the money, you can't just stand aside and say yes."

The air was quiet for two seconds.

Qi Yanci suddenly twitched the corners of his lips.

It's so shallow that it's almost invisible.

"There are a lot of lies."

Shi Xiahe couldn't tell whether this was a compliment or a sarcasm, so he could only lower his head: "You're right."

Qi Yanci: "..."

He didn't answer any more, turned around and walked to the master bedroom with a towel and water.

There was no mention of carrying the medicine bag.

Shi Xiahe stood there and slowly clenched his fingers.

She could tell that Qi Yanci didn't believe her.

In other words, he only allowed her to cook, pass water, and obey the rules.

He wouldn't hand it over to her easily when it came to things that really involved his body.

It doesn't matter.

At least he didn't chase her away.

As long as she stays here, she still has a chance.

When Shi Xiahe returned to the guest room, his cell phone just rang.

She picked up the phone.

Jiang Ning asked: "Ah He, the landlord said you moved away? Where did you move to?"

Time for a meal in summer.

She signed a confidentiality agreement and could not reveal Jiangyu Mansion or say she was married in a fake way, so she just said: "I found a new job, which provided food and accommodation, and then moved out."

Jiang Ning breathed a sigh of relief: "That's great. At least you don't have to squeeze into a rented apartment with that scumbag anymore."

After a pause, she asked again: "Are you okay? Do you want to come out for a drink? I'll scold him with you."

Shi Xiahe looked at the time and saw that it was already getting late.

"Forget it for today, don't worry, I'm fine."
